{{Quote|Hello. Are you making the city tour?|The red-headed woman to Panaka|<ref name="TPM game" />}}
An '''unidentified Human female''' with [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was staying on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. She was present in [[Coruscant City Tours]]' terminal when the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to plead her people's case before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. That [[Standard day/Legends|day]], she was wearing a grey [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with red sleeves.<ref name="TPM game" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], Chief of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security Force]], tried to sell his [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]] to the red-head woman so he could buy two tickets for the city tour. The woman, however, declined Panaka's offer, stating that she had no use for such a device.<ref name="TPM game" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
That red-headed woman only appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]].<ref name="TPM game" /> As an in-game [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]], the game's development team made several NPCs to look like real-world celebrities. This particular merchant was given the appearance of the famous actress [[Wikipedia:Gilian Anderson|Gilian Anderson]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.lucasforums.com/showthread.php?t=5630&page=5|text=TPM Q & A - Page 5|author="[[Ray West (3D artist)|Zanzibar]]"|date=2001-08-13, 4:51 AM|work=[https://archive.is/bVr5 LucasForums]|quote=Congrats to Jedi72, you got 'em!|archiveurl=https://archive.is/UfaYE}}</ref>
